title: Sales Channels
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Marketplace share of revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'marketplace' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.status <> 'returned'

kpis.label: Mobile app share of revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'mobile_app' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.status <> 'returned'

kpis.label: Marketplace average order
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.status <> 'returned' AND o.channel = 'marketplace'

kpis.label: Marketplace share of revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'marketplace' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

kpis.label: Mobile app share of revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'mobile_app' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

kpis.label: Marketplace average order
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.channel = 'marketplace'

density.rule: each series of a split line
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.status <> 'returned' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts), o.channel)
